Name: The Secret Oracle
Author: secsky3
Description:
# 🔮 The Secret Oracle (비밀 점술가)

> *"Greetings, traveler of fate... Welcome to 'The Secret Oracle', unraveling the unseen threads of tomorrow."*

Tired of the simple daily luck predictions from the spirits? **The Secret Oracle** introduces an immersive, paid occult television channel that accurately deciphers the game's actual internal seeds and upcoming RNG events!

Spend your hard-earned gold to plan your day efficiently, hunt rare treasures, and uncover the valley's deepest secrets.

---

## ✨ Features & Prophecies

Turn on any TV in your farmhouse and tune into **"The Secret Oracle"**!

### 🔮 1. Basic Fortunes (Available from Day 1)
* ⛏️ **Mine Prophecy**: Predicts exact **Mushroom Floors (81-119)**, **Infested Monster Floors**, and primordial **Prehistoric Dinosaur Floors** in the Skull Cavern.
* 🗑️ **Garbage Prophecy**: Scans all 8 town garbage cans to foresee rare treasures (**Garbage Hat**, **Trash Catalogue**) or fresh hot cooked meals before you search them.
* 🌙 **Night Event Prophecy**: Foretells mysterious night visitations (**Crop Fairy**, **Witch**, **Purple Meteorite**, **Strange Capsule**, **Stone Owl**, or the fallen giant tree windstorm) occurring tonight or over the next 7 days.
* 🔮 **All Three Fortunes**: Receive all basic prophecies at once with convenient all-in-one pricing.

### 🌟 2. Special Fortunes (Unlocked as you progress)
* 🌋 **Volcano Forge Enchantments**: Peeks into the forge's fiery heart to reveal the exact enchantment waiting for your carried weapon and tools (*Requires visiting Ginger Island*).
* 🦜 **Island Gem Birds**: Decodes the weather spirits to reveal the 4 sacred gems required for the rainy jungle shrine (*Requires Ginger Island, hidden once solved*).
* 🎟️ **Mayor's Prize Ticket Machine**: Reveals the exact reward waiting in Lewis's prize machine (*Unlocked after your first prize ticket*).
* 🦝 **Raccoon Neighbor's Craving**: Detects the specific foraging and artisan items the giant tree raccoon family will ask for next (*Unlocked after giant tree quest*).
* 💎 **Geode Radiance**: Simulates Clint's anvil for the next 50 cracked geodes, alerting you to Prismatic Shards, Pearls, Treasure Chests, and rare minerals (*Unlocked after opening geodes*).

---

## 💰 Fair Pricing & Daily Perks

* **Pay Once Per Day**: Re-viewing any fortune you have already purchased today is **free** (marked as `[Paid]`).
* **Smart Bundle Discount**: Selecting "All Fortunes" automatically discounts any individual fortunes you have already paid for today.
* **Fully Configurable**: All prices and repeat-charge rules can be customized via **Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)** or `config.json`.
  * Basic Fortune default: `300g`
  * Special Fortune default: `10,000g`

---

## 🌐 Language Support
* **English** (Default)
* **한국어** (Korean - 완성형 2,350자 바닐라 폰트 완벽 대응, 폰트 깨짐 없음)

---

## 🛠️ Installation & Compatibility
1. Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2. Download **The Secret Oracle** and unzip it into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
3. Launch the game using SMAPI!

* **Stardew Valley 1.6+ & SMAPI 4.0+ compatible**
* Safe to add or remove at any time without corrupting save files.
* Fully compatible with **Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)** and **Ridgeside Village (RSV)**.
* Multiplayer safe (clients will read their individual fortunes/counters).
